_about: Curated drug-drug and drug-disease interactions relevant to the therapy options RetiLink shows. Each cites the label or guideline; always read the full label. Not a complete interaction checker.

pairs.title: Dual RAS blockade
pairs.detail: Combining an ACE inhibitor with an ARB raises the risk of hyperkalaemia and acute kidney injury without added benefit (ONTARGET, VA NEPHRON-D). Use one.
pairs.source: ADA Standards of Care, Section 10; lisinopril and losartan labels

pairs.title: Hyperkalaemia risk
pairs.detail: Mineralocorticoid receptor antagonists with an ACE inhibitor or ARB raise potassium. Check potassium and eGFR before starting and during treatment.
pairs.source: Finerenone and spironolactone labels, Warnings: hyperkalaemia

pairs.title: Hypoglycaemia with insulin or a sulfonylurea
pairs.detail: Adding an SGLT2 inhibitor or GLP-1 receptor agonist to insulin or a sulfonylurea increases hypoglycaemia; a lower insulin or sulfonylurea dose may be needed.
pairs.source: Empagliflozin and semaglutide labels, Warnings: hypoglycaemia with insulin or secretagogues

pairs.title: Myopathy with a statin
pairs.detail: Fibrate plus statin increases the risk of myopathy and rhabdomyolysis; fenofibrate is preferred over gemfibrozil when combining. Monitor for muscle symptoms.
pairs.source: Fenofibrate label, Warnings: myopathy and rhabdomyolysis

pairs.title: Duplicate incretin therapy
pairs.detail: A GLP-1 receptor agonist and a DPP-4 inhibitor act on the same pathway; stop the DPP-4 inhibitor when starting a GLP-1 receptor agonist.

disease.title: Diabetic retinopathy complications
disease.detail: Semaglutide was associated with more DR complications in SUSTAIN-6, linked to rapid glucose lowering. With a retinopathy signal, arrange retinal follow-up before and after starting.
disease.source: Semaglutide label, Warnings: diabetic retinopathy complications; ADA Standards of Care, Section 12

disease.title: Macular edema with pioglitazone
disease.detail: Thiazolidinediones have been associated with new or worsening macular edema. With a macular edema signal, review the need for pioglitazone and refer.

disease.title: Check eGFR before continuing metformin
disease.detail: Metformin is contraindicated below eGFR 30 and should not be started between 30 and 45. A kidney signal is a prompt to check eGFR.
disease.source: Metformin label, Contraindications and Warnings: lactic acidosis

disease.title: Dose by kidney function
disease.detail: Pregabalin and gabapentin are cleared by the kidney; reduce the dose when creatinine clearance is low.
disease.source: Pregabalin label, Dosage in renal impairment
